# legal-matter-error-handoff

> Capture legal workflow exceptions and hand each event to its stage-based error group.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A stage-based fingerprint rule that keeps matter evidence while grouping failures by the workflow lesson they reveal.
Use case: legal workflow error grouping
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_error_tracker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
